engineering_pillars: Pillar 1: Machine Design & Production Lines (طراحی ماشین‌آلات و خطوط تولید - استانداردسازی چرخ‌دنده‌ها، مکانیزم‌های انتقال قدرت و طراحی برای ساخت DFMA)
Pillar 2: Factory Troubleshooting & Line Optimization (مشاوره فنی، عیب‌یابی ارتعاشات و رفع توقف خطوط - حذف ارتعاشات مخرب و جلوگیری از رها شدن اشپیل‌ها)
Pillar 3: Industrial R&D & Prototyping (تحقیق، توسعه و امکان‌سنجی خطوط مونتاژ سرعت‌بالا، پخت چسب و کوتینگ پیوسته UV LED)

dymax_uv_emitters.peak_irradiance: Up to 4.2 W/cm² (4200 mW/cm²) uniform linear energy
dymax_uv_emitters.thermal_profile: Cold-cure solid-state LED arrays, zero thermal distortion on thin polymers and delicate optics
dymax_uv_emitters.automation_integration: Direct mountable over inline conveyors, indexing rotary tables, and multi-axis gantry robots

supported_profiles: Internal & Ring Gears (چرخ‌دنده‌های رینگی و خورشیدی)
Straight & Spiral Bevel Gears (چرخ‌دنده‌های مخروطی پینیون)
Worms & Worm Wheels (پیچ و چرخ‌حلزون خودقفل‌شونده)
materials: Stainless Steel (SUS303, SUS304, SUS316) for Food & Pharma
Engineering Plastics (POM / Acetal, MC Nylon) Lubrication-free
Phosphor Bronze & Brass for Heavy Worm Drives
Cast Iron (FC200 / FC250) for High Dynamic Damping
khk_metric_gears.engineering_impact: Eliminates bespoke hobbing lead times, cuts tool wear costs, guarantees ISO/JIS precision grades with known backlash limits

operational_mechanisms.slic_pin: Spring-loaded wedge detent built directly into the pin shank; automatically retracts upon insertion and springs open upon exit; toolless single-hand assembly
operational_mechanisms.bow_tie_cotter: Contoured spring wire designed to wrap around shaft perimeter and snap onto itself; cannot be dislodged by vibration, snagging wires, or accidental impacts
operational_mechanisms.rue_ring: 360-degree circumferential locking cotter engineered for high dynamic shear and severe multi-axial mechanical vibration

pivot_point_fasteners.plant_benefits: Up to 75% reduction in pin assembly cycle time, 100% elimination of missing split pins (Poka-Yoke), zero maintenance stops from detached fasteners
